{"metadata":{"description":"Reasoning-effort editing for third-party models in DeepSeek Harness: per-model thinking levels with a knowledge base + protocol inference, edited inside the official Models page card.","id":"gh:1339889879","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-better-reasoning-effort","slug":"HaoyueQin/dsh-better-reasoning-effort","topics":["automation","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","llm","plugin","react","reasoning","reasoning-effort","settings","typescript","web"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Reasoning-effort editing for third-party models in DeepSeek Harness: per-model thinking levels with "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"a knowledge base + protocol inference, edited inside the official Models page card."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Better Reasoning Effort"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Reasoning-effort **and input-modality** editing for **third-party models** in DeepSeek Harness, edit"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ed right inside the official Models page card — plus a quick reasoning-effort slider inside the offi"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"cial composer model menu (adapted from HanaAyane's dsh-reasoning-effort, see Acknowledgements)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The `llm-pi-ai` adapter natively supports per-model `reasoningEfforts` and `input` declarations, but"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" the official Models page editor deliberately keeps both fields out of reach. As a result, third-par"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ty models get **no thinking-level picker** in the composer, only the official DeepSeek API can set r"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"easoning effort, hand-declared models are treated as **text-only**, and configuring any of this mean"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"t hand-writing `settings.yaml` blocks. This plugin brings both configuration surfaces back into the "},{"id":"p6s6","text":"UI: edit inside the official model editor card, plus one-click auto-adapt."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **In-page editor** — an "Options" block appears under each model row's disclosure on the official "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"Models page (reasoning effort, input modalities, endpoint compatibility), committing with the card's"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" own **Save**; changes stay pending until then, and **Cancel** discards them with the card's fields."},{"id":"p8s4","text":"
- **Auto-adapt** — one click fills recommended levels, wire spellings and modalities from a built-i"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"n knowledge base (65 entries across 15 vendors — see Supported models), wire-protocol inference, and"},{"id":"p8s6","text":" a same-origin probe of the provider's raw `/models` listing, every suggestion labeled by confidence"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"; reference capacities show as read-only hints you copy yourself.
- **Auto-fill** — models with a cu"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"rated official knowledge-base match are filled at boot and when added mid-session (opt out via `auto"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"fill: false` / `modalityAutofill: false`); unknown models stay unchanged until the user explicitly a"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"ccepts Auto-adapt.
- **Three intents** — all levels off = unset (back to inheritance); only `off` = "},{"id":"p8s11","text":"disable reasoning; levels armed = write the declaration.
- **Catalog-safe writes** — routes using DS"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"H's official `modelOverrides` keep their installed catalog; only the edited model override is writte"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"n.
- **Composer slider** — the official model menu's body is replaced by an upstream-style effort sl"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"ider (drag / keyboard, optimistic commit with rollback), with one model row opening the official mod"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"el list; the official trigger stays untouched, and model switches keep your level through a per-sess"},{"id":"p8s16","text":"ion memory chain (issue #4's per-model default effort outranks it across sessions).
- **Per-model de"},{"id":"p8s17","text":"fault effort** — a "Default effort" picker on each model row, stored in the settings document; every"},{"id":"p8s18","text":" new session starts the model there.
- **Request headers & `user-agent`** — a provider-card section "},{"id":"p8s19","text":"edits the official `headers` field (masked, path-merged, Save-gated), and the plugin performs the `u"},{"id":"p8s20","text":"ser-agent` override at the fetch layer per origin, because the official adapter reserves that name; "},{"id":"p8s21","text":"same-origin `/models` probes are covered, conflicts are reported rather than guessed.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Supported models"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The auto-adapt knowledge base carries **65 curated entries across 15 vendors** (DeepSeek, OpenAI, An"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"thropic Claude, Gemini, Grok, Qwen, GLM, Kimi, Mistral, MiniMax, MiMo, Doubao, Hunyuan, Step, ERNIE "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"— re-verified against official docs 2026-08/09, including vision-capable variants and no-effort-cont"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"rol families). The full table — match patterns, level → wire-spelling ladders, defaults, modalities,"},{"id":"p10s5","text":" reference capacities — lives in **docs/supported-models.md** (generated from `src/knowledge.ts`, th"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"e authoritative source). Unlisted models are left unchanged by automatic fill; the user can still re"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"view a low-confidence Auto-adapt suggestion."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- `suggestEfforts()` in `src/knowledge.ts` is the knowledge base + inference engine — a pure functio"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"n shared by host and browser.
- `reconcile()` in `src/client/injection/models-page-editor.ts` locate"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"s model rows and mounts the editor; `src/client/index.ts` assembles the browser half, one module per"},{"id":"p13s4","text":" seam in `src/client/injection/`.
- `createEditorApi()` in `src/client/ops.ts` writes the declaratio"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"ns via `settings.mutate`, preserving every other row field and retrying once on a revision conflict."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- Injection depends on the official Models page's DOM (aria-label/class); an official upgrade may pa"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"use injection until adapted — the official page is unaffected meanwhile.
- The auto-adapt probe rout"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"e answers **loopback and IP-literal hosts only** (the core `/api` Host-allowlist discipline without "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"`trustedHosts`), and **never follows redirects** — a gateway listing its models only behind a 30x si"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"mply yields no endpoint evidence; Auto-adapt falls back to the knowledge base and protocol inference"},{"id":"p15s6","text":".
- `reasoningEfforts` declarations are suggestions — what an endpoint actually accepts is up to its"},{"id":"p15s7","text":" docs; tweak in the UI. The knowledge base is not exhaustive; families without an effort ladder carr"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"y no entry at all.
- Endpoint-compatibility switches are never auto-filled by design: they describe "},{"id":"p15s9","text":"a gateway, not a model.
- The modality vocabulary follows pi-ai's core (`text` / `image` today); wid"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"er gateway support (PDF, audio, video) is recorded per family until the core vocabulary grows.
- Nam"},{"id":"p15s11","text":"e-heuristic modality advice (vision-flavored ids) is deliberately low-confidence and labeled as such"},{"id":"p15s12","text":".
- Self-hosted relays: auto-fill pins `supportsDeveloperRole: false` on routes no official host cla"},{"id":"p15s13","text":"ims (some upstreams reject the `developer` role); explicit values are never overwritten.
- Forced-th"},{"id":"p15s14","text":"inking models (ladders without `off`, e.g. GLM-5.3): effort-less calls map to the vendor default ins"},{"id":"p15s15","text":"tead of sending `thinking: disabled` — set `defaultGuard: false` to restore raw behavior. A route-le"},{"id":"p15s16","text":"vel `reasoning` default covers the same calls without the guard: the adapter resolves `options.reaso"},{"id":"p15s17","text":"ningEffort ?? profile.reasoning`, so a route that names one never reaches the off-equivalent (and th"},{"id":"p15s18","text":"e guard steps aside for it).
- The guard's activity is reported inside the request-header section (`"},{"id":"p15s19","text":"N` effort-less calls rewritten, and the model of the most recent one), so an installed-but-idle fall"},{"id":"p15s20","text":"back is distinguishable from one that is working; the same report is served at `/dsh-better-reasonin"},{"id":"p15s21","text":"g-effort/headers-config`.
